text:
mia: quick sync — inbound routing SLA proposal. idea: when enrichment latency spikes, enter a "degrade mode": assign to fallback queue but keep original owner sticky until enrichment finishes. thoughts? :wave:
jordan: +1 on fallback queue. question: what threshold do we use? 10s? seems low for some partners.
sam: FYI measured enrichment p95 ~8s, p99 ~18s. 10s catches p99 spikes. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
ravi: we need a heartbeat from HubSpot webhooks to keep the owner sticky. right now owner TTL drops after ~30s. can we extend TTL via SF mapping?
cleo: on the SF side we can add a "claim_hold" boolean via API and set TTL to 2m. small change, low-risk.
mia: ops-bot: please put minimal deploy checklist below.
ops-bot: deploy checklist: 1) apply hs workflow patch, 2) SF mapping PR merged, 3) rollout 10% canary, 4) monitor owner_reassign_rate and enrich_latency for 15m.
jordan: rough HubSpot workflow pseudocode:
```
if enrichment_latency > 10s:
  set owner = fallback_queue
  set claim_hold = true
  schedule enrichment retry in 30s
```
ravi: also add metrics: owner_reassign_rate and enrichment_latency_tagged. alert if owner_reassign_rate > 0.5% over 15m.
sam: propose canary plan: enable for a single region + SMB accounts first, watch SDR drop-offs.
mia: rollout plan: canary 7am PST tomorrow -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% if owner_reassign_rate < 0.5% and no SDR complaints. :rocket:
cleo: I'll draft the SF PR + hubspot workflow patch. ETA EOD today.
mia: thanks — I'll update the handoff playbook and add a short runbook for oncall (how to revert, metrics to inspect).
jordan: :thumbsup:
ravi: pinging @eng-sre to watch alerts during rollout and own rollback if needed.
sam: small UX ask: send email notification to SDRs when owner is moved to fallback so they can triage.
mia: noted — we'll add notification in the workflow. will post status here when PRs are up.
